subtitulo: Mira, no sé qué te dijeron... ¡Oye, qué bonito!
regla: The commands of mirar and oír (mira, mire, miren; oye, oiga, oigan) are often fillers, not orders. Mira: to get attention before saying something (often firm), or ironic surprise (mira tú, mira nada más). Oye: to get attention, to protest, or to show surprise or admiration.

lista.texto: _Look, ..._ before an explanation or a firm point: **Mire, aquí no hacemos devoluciones sin ticket.**

lista.forma: mira (tú) / mira nada más: irony, surprise
lista.texto: _Well, what do you know..._: **Y mira tú, ahora su hijo se levanta a las once.**
_Hey, ..._ to start talking or call someone: **Oiga, ¿me cobra?**
_Hey!_ **¡Oye, no te metas en la fila!**

bloques.texto: Match the form to the listener: **mira / oye** (tú), **mire / oiga** (usted), **miren / oigan** (ustedes).
**Oiga** is the polite way to call a waiter or a stranger in Mexico.
Tip: they're the verbal tap on the shoulder: _look_ and _listen_.

lista.en: Look, I think you should calm down.

lista.es: ==Miren==, no sé qué les dijeron, pero sin ticket no hay devolución.
lista.en: Look, I don't know what you were told, but no receipt, no refund.

lista.es: Me decía que mi hija era floja, y ==mira tú==, ahora su hijo no se levanta.
lista.en: She said my daughter was lazy, and what do you know, now her son won't get up.

lista.es: No había nada, pero ==mire nada más==, acaba de llegar mercancía.
lista.en: We were out, but would you believe it, new stock just came in.
Excuse me, could you bring me the check?

lista.es: ==Oye==, qué rico te quedó el mole.
lista.en: Wow, your mole turned out delicious.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Call a waiter politely: _Excuse me, the menu?_
Firm start to a friend: _Look, I can't lend you money._
lista.r: Mira, no te puedo prestar dinero.

lista.p: Irony: _And what do you know, it rained after all._
lista.r: Y mira tú, al final sí llovió.
